name: Occipital probe
description: Control-region probe over the occipital lobe, reproducing the layout shown in Figure 11a of the thesis. Low optode density by design: 2 EEG electrodes, 1 fNIRS source, 1 fNIRS detector, 1 fDCS source and 1 fDCS detector, with separations matched to the lateral probe. The physical probe also carries a rectangular accelerometer in a dedicated slot; its coordinates are not recorded in the source notebook, so it is not represented here and does not act as an obstacle in the clearance check.
